secrets.name: GOOGLE_WALLET_ISSUER_ID
secrets.description: Google Wallet issuer id (Google Pay & Wallet console, Manage tab). The app stores it with the key so both arrive together.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_WALLET_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
secrets.description: The service account key JSON, pasted whole (Google Cloud console > IAM & Admin > Service accounts > Keys > Add key > JSON). Its client_email must be invited as a Developer user in the Wallet console.
